entities.name: Helga Hošková-Weissová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Helga Hošková-Weissová, also Helga Weiss, is a Czech artist, and a Holocaust survivor. She is known for her drawings that depict life at Terezín and her diary, which was published in 2013.
